summary: Only on 1h, and mostly in uptrends. After price crossed down through 0.97 of its EMA 20, it beat random entries by 0.46% after 20 candles, and the result holds without its strongest stretch and at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles. Price / EMA 50 above 1.01 and rising also beat random on 1h, by 0.35%, while the same dip settings on daily did worse than random.

notes: Long entries as price crossed down through 0.97 of its EMA 20 on 1h gave 2,141 entries in 981 separate moves. Twenty candles later they were 0.46% ahead of random entries, above the top of the luck band at 0.28%. The result holds without its strongest stretch, May 16–18, 2021, and at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles, and BTC, ETH and SOL each beat random. The shallower cross down through 0.99 fires about three times as often and did the same as random.

The 1h dip result came from uptrends. With the pair above its 200-day SMA, the 0.97 cross beat random by 0.69%. Below it, the gap was 0.09%, the same as random. On daily, both dip settings did worse than random after 20 days, the 0.97 cross by 4.14% and the 0.99 cross by 2.44%, and both losses came from uptrends, at 4.52% and 4.73% worse.

Holding long while Price / EMA 50 sat above 1.01 and rising beat random by 0.35% on 1h. It holds without its strongest stretch, between Dec 31, 2020 and Jan 8, 2021, and at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles. It came from uptrends, 0.36% ahead, and from SOL, 0.46% ahead, while downtrends and BTC were the same as random. On 4h and daily it is fragile, resting on one stretch each: between Jul 22 and Sep 10, 2021, and between Jul 30 and Nov 9, 2021.

Shorting as price crossed up through 1.03 of its EMA 20 did 0.53% worse than random on 1h. It shows at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles and holds without its strongest stretch. The loss came from uptrends, at 0.59% worse, and in downtrends it was the same as random. On 4h the loss is fragile, resting on Aug 2–15, 2021, and on daily it was the same as random.

The EMA 20 / EMA 50 cross up was the same as random on 1h, 4h and daily when both regimes are pooled. In downtrends on 1h it beat random by 0.29%, but only at 20 and 50 candles. On 4h the downtrend gain of 1.09% is fragile. On daily, each regime has fewer than 30 separate moves, too few to judge.

On 1h, the 0.97 dip and the rising EMA 50 condition are the two shapes that beat random, and both came from uptrends. A long DCA bot can use either as a filter beside its own start condition, limited to times when the pair trades above its 200-day SMA, with take profit and DCA handling the exit. Below that average, both shapes did the same as random. On daily, the 0.97 and 0.99 dip conditions are a reason to leave the setting out, and a short bot opening on a 1.03 stretch on 1h traded against the trend.
